paite: Vuah nanung hun in TOUPA vuah ngen un, meipite bawlpa TOUPA mahmah, huchi in vuahphinte, gam a loupate kiang ah, amaute ape ding.
heading: TOUPA'N Hotkhiakna Achiam

paite: Milimte'n bangmah lou thu agen un, aisante'n zuau amu uh; mang zuauthei agen ua, athawn lel in alungmuan uh; huaiziak in belamte bang in amau lampi ah apai ua, belamchingmi a-om louh ziak in hihgim in a-om uhi.
"Belamching mite tung ah ka hehna apuakzak a, aheutute uh ka gawt ding, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Judah inkote, abelamte avehta a, kidouna a sakol hoih bang in amaute abawl ding hi.
Amah a kipan in aning a suang, amah a kipan puanin khetphim amah a kipan kidouna thalpeu, amah a kipan vaihawm tengteng ahong paikhe ding hi.
Kidouna a kongzing a buannawi a amelmate uh childen in, mihatte bang in a-om ding ua; akiang ua TOUPA a-om ziak in adou ding uh; sakol tung a tuangte hih lungzin in a-om ding uhi."

"Judah inkote ka hatsak ding a, Joseph inkote ka hondam ding, amaute ka hon pi nawn ding a, amau tung ah zahngaihna ka nei; huchi in ka paihkhiak het louh bang ahong hi ding uh; TOUPA a Pathian uh ka hi a, amaute ka dawng ding hi.
Ephraim mite mihatpa in a-om ding ua, uain ziak in alungtang uh akipak ding a; ahi, atate un huai amu ding ua, akipak ding uh; TOUPA ah alungtang uh akipak ding hi.
Amau ka khutvan ding a, amau ka kaikhawm ding; amau ka tanta hi; apun khitsa bang un apung ding uh.
Namte lak ah hawldalh mah leng; gam gamlate ah kei ahon theigige ding uh; huchi in atate uh toh ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn ding uhi.
Aigupta gam a pan ka pi nawn ding a, Assuria a kipan ka pikik nawn ding hi; Gilead leh Lebanon gam ah amau ka pilut ding; amaute a dia mun akidaih louh dong in

gimthuakna tuipi apalkai ding ua, tuipi a tui kihawtte khet in a-om ding uh, huchi in Nile luipi thukna tengteng akang vek ding; Assuria kisaktheihna koihniam in a-om dia, Aigupta kumpi chiang apaimang vengveng ding hi.
Huan TOUPA ah amau ka hihhat ding a; amin in avaktou un avaksuk ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
